changes.title: Oil Giant Saudi Aramco Reports 33% Profit Surge, Despite Iran War Disruptions
changes.summary: Higher oil prices propelled a quarterly earnings jump for Saudi Arabia’s energy giant, which used pipelines to work around disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Trump Says He Canceled Strikes on Iran, Claiming Progress on Outlines of a Deal
changes.summary: President Trump has repeatedly threatened to escalate the war with Iran, only to abruptly back down. Saudi Arabia said its leader had urged Mr. Trump not to renew attacks.

changes.title: Week in Politics: Iran War; Trump attends solemn ritual; nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia
changes.summary: The Trump administration is seeking tens of billions of dollars in supplemental appropriations for the Iran War, a war which the president and allies have repeatedly claimed is already won.

changes.title: Saudi military strikes Houthi targets in Yemen after Iran-backed militia attacked Red Sea shipping
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia intercepted two ballistic missiles from Yemen, Greek security sources told Reuters, as fighting in a second front in the Iran war escalates.

changes.title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia as Middle East war widens
changes.summary: Yemeni rebels accuse Saudis of ‘dangerous escalation’ as tit-for-tat strikes mark new front in war that has engulfed region Iran-backed Houthi rebels vowed to retaliate against Saudi Arabia on Saturday after they accused the kingdom of targeting civilian infrastructure, as the Middle East war widens across the region.

changes.title: Cornell, Northwestern and Other Universities Plan for Classes at Middle East Campuses
changes.summary: Even after the collapse of the cease-fire between the United States and Iran, American universities expect to teach in Qatar and the United Arab Emirates, and a new outpost is on track to open in Saudi Arabia.

changes.title: Trump says "nobody got out ahead" of him on Saudi nuclear deal announcement after changing terms
changes.summary: President Trump took questions from reporters the day after he seemed to upend a nuclear agreement with Saudi Arabia by adding a new condition: that the country join the Abraham Accords. CBS News White House reporter Olivia Rinaldi has the details.

changes.title: Israel Welcomes Trump’s Demand for Diplomatic Ties With Saudi Arabia
changes.summary: Israeli officials embraced the possibility of normalized ties, but analysts said the U.S.-Saudi nuclear deal nonetheless remained bad for Israel.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Trump administration signs nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia, Trump ramps up aggression against Iran despite declining support, House passes Pentagon funding bill.
